title: Add global gitignore creation and security pattern audit

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Adding audit_global_gitignore and apply_global_gitignore functions. Audit checks core.excludesFile config and scans existing file for security patterns. Apply creates ~/.config/git/ignore with security-focused patterns.
